purpose: Bounded postmerge diagnosis and conditional generic Markdown redirect fallback; never pretend scanner success or restore missing request intent.

diagnostic.place: last; validate existing Transform budget first

rule.expression: http.host eq "piskor.com.ua" and http.request.method eq "GET" and http.request.uri.path in {"" "/"} and http.request.uri.query eq "" and raw.http.request.uri.path in {"" "/"} and raw.http.request.uri.query eq "" and http.response.code eq 200 and starts_with(lower(http.response.headers["content-type"][0]), "text/html") and http.request.timestamp.sec ge START_SECOND and http.request.timestamp.sec lt END_SECOND

content-type.expression: concat("text/html; charset=utf-8; piskor-diag=\"md1-START_SECOND\"; piskor-accept=\"", encode_base64(substring(coalesce(join(http.request.headers["accept"], "|"), ""), 0, 128), "u"), "\"; piskor-count=", to_string(coalesce(len(http.request.headers["accept"]), 0)), "; piskor-length=", to_string(coalesce(len(join(http.request.headers["accept"], "|")), 0)))

activation_gate: Only after merging this PR, successful main Pages, live artifact parity and CF validation. One ordinary HTML control and one Markdown-only scanner invocation within the literal window. Disable diagnostic and verify normal MIME before any fallback trial.
decision_gate: After disabling the diagnostic and verifying normal MIME, allow one independently bounded root-only early-phase exact-Accept307 trial, even if later-phase Accept differs or marker is absent. Fields may change between phases; the predicate itself requires one exact text/markdown and never reconstructs intent. Missing/no-match/failure remains inconclusive; retain/expand only after fresh uninstrumented scanner PASS plus controls and the full matrix.

rule.description: PISKOR Markdown temporary redirect: public directory pages
rule.expression: (http.host eq "piskor.com.ua" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and len(http.request.headers["accept"]) eq 1 and http.request.headers["accept"][0] eq "text/markdown" and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/agent-markdown/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/agent-api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/agent-skills/") and http.request.uri.query eq "" and not http.request.uri.path contains "%" and not http.request.uri.path contains "\\" and not http.request.uri.path contains "//" and not http.request.uri.path contains "/./" and not http.request.uri.path contains "/../"

rule.description: PISKOR Markdown temporary redirect: explicit English 404 document
rule.expression: (http.host eq "piskor.com.ua" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and len(http.request.headers["accept"]) eq 1 and http.request.headers["accept"][0] eq "text/markdown" and http.request.uri.path eq "/404.html" and http.request.uri.query eq "lang=en" and not http.request.uri.path contains "%" and not http.request.uri.path contains "\\" and not http.request.uri.path contains "//" and not http.request.uri.path contains "/./" and not http.request.uri.path contains "/../"

rule.description: PISKOR Markdown temporary redirect: explicit 404 document URL
rule.expression: (http.host eq "piskor.com.ua" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and len(http.request.headers["accept"]) eq 1 and http.request.headers["accept"][0] eq "text/markdown" and http.request.uri.path eq "/404.html" and http.request.uri.query in {"" "lang=uk"} and not http.request.uri.path contains "%" and not http.request.uri.path contains "\\" and not http.request.uri.path contains "//" and not http.request.uri.path contains "/./" and not http.request.uri.path contains "/../"

rollback: Disable only new redirect rules if uninstrumented scanner or parity/negative/cache matrix fails. Disable/expire diagnostic even on errors. Keep original rewrites, MIME/policy/cache rules and other zone settings unchanged.

rule.description: PISKOR bounded exact Markdown root redirect trial
rule.expression: http.host eq "piskor.com.ua" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.request.uri.query eq "" and raw.http.request.uri.path eq "/" and raw.http.request.uri.query eq "" and len(http.request.headers["accept"]) eq 1 and http.request.headers["accept"][0] eq "text/markdown" and http.request.timestamp.sec ge START_SECOND and http.request.timestamp.sec lt END_SECOND
